principle: A spec is a contract. An agent can only execute what's been framed clearly enough to execute.
paragraphs: The PM's job isn't to write better prompts. It's to write specs sharp enough that any competent executor - human, agent, or otherwise - can act on them without interpretation.
This is uncomfortable because it means the ambiguity sits with you, not the agent. You can't hide behind 'the model got confused.'
The payoff: every spec you sharpen compounds across every agent you ever run with it.
